title: Architecting Agent Memory: Principles, Patterns, and Best Practices — Richmond Alake, MongoDB
talk_summary: High-level MongoDB talk argues agents need memory management across generation, storage, retrieval, integration, updating, and deletion, with patterns like persona, toolbox, conversation, workflow, and agent-registry memory. It offers conceptual patterns and a library but little measured evidence; the copyable ideas are structured memory stores and retrieval-before-context.

takeaways.what_they_do: Store failed execution steps and outcomes as experience, then retrieve them in later runs to warn the model away from bad paths.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the failure is experience. It's learning experience. You can store that in your database

takeaways.technique: Toolbox memory with dynamic tool retrieval
takeaways.what_they_do: Store tool JSON schemas in a database and retrieve only relevant tools before the LLM call instead of putting all schemas in context.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you can just get the relevant tool using any form of search

takeaways.technique: Curated memory bundle instead of full history
takeaways.what_they_do: Treat large context windows as space for relevant retrieved memory, not for stuffing all data; organize retrieved memories for the response.
takeaways.evidence_quote: That's for you to pull in the relevant memory and structure them in a way that is effective

takeaways.what_they_do: Attach recall/recency/association metadata to memories and implement decay or forgetting rather than keeping everything forever.
takeaways.evidence_quote: implementing forgetting mechanisms within the memory management systems that we're building

takeaways.what_they_do: Store agent information such as tools, persona, and capabilities in an agent registry so the system can reason about available agents.
takeaways.evidence_quote: agent registry, you can store the information of your agent as well

takeaways.what_they_do: Give the agent retrieval capability as a callable tool so it decides when to fetch relevant information.
takeaways.evidence_quote: give the retrieval capability to the agent as a tool
